# probe-core/tests/fixtures/vectors

Text manifests of reference values produced by OpenSSL.

- `digestinfo.txt` — PKCS#1 `DigestInfo` per hash
- `digests.txt` — digest of the fixture message per hash
- `ecdsa.txt` — raw and DER ECDSA signature pairs per curve and shape
- `fingerprints.txt` — SHA-256 of each certificate's DER
- `signatures.txt` — signatures per key, algorithm, and hash
- `validity.txt` — serial, notBefore, and notAfter per certificate
